d: Are you pushing yourself to the limit but finding yourself sidelined by injuries? In this video, we dive deep into the three biggest training errors that could be holding you back from reaching your fitness goals! Discover why neglecting proper stretching and strength training can lead to serious injuries, and learn how to incorporate effective techniques to improve your form. Are you eager to increase your running distance? We’ll discuss the dangers of building up your mileage too fast and provide tips to gradually and safely increase your training load.
